title: Git City config (v1)
description: Customises the Git City island generated from a GitHub profile. Publish it as .git-city/city.json in your profile repository (<login>/<login>). Data only: Git City validates every field, ignores unknown keys and never loads URLs from it. Git City is more lenient than this schema: over-long text is shortened and out-of-range numbers are clamped instead of rejected. See https://github.com/schlunsen/git-city/blob/main/docs/city-config.md

$schema.description: Editor hint only; Git City never loads it.

name.description: Shown on the welcome boards and in the profile card.

shape.description: Footprint of the paved city block.

welcome.description: Message on the welcome boards where the roads leave town.

accent.description: Glow colour of the plaza monument and its inlays.

time.description: Starting light; visitors can still change it.

weather.description: Starting weather; visitors can still change it.

tv.description: Old-television (CRT) look on or off when your city opens; visitors can still toggle it.

fx.description: Bloom / colour grade / grain on or off when your city opens; visitors can still toggle it.

timezone.description: Your IANA time zone, e.g. "Europe/Copenhagen" or "Asia/Tokyo": the city's automatic day and night follow your local time.

landmarks.description: Attractions placed first (best effort: each needs a free site of the right kind).

neighbours.description: GitHub logins reached by flying off the map; topped up automatically.

featured.description: Your repositories, in order: built next to the plaza and advertised first on the country billboards.

hide.description: Your repositories to leave out of the city.

style.description: Silhouette: tower with a spire, stepped tower, cottage with a pitched roof, or a plain block. Height still follows the stars.

color.description: Facade colour (instead of the language colour).

sign.description: Text on the building's shop signs and rooftop board.

billboard.description: Text on this repository's country billboard.

neon.description: Night glow colour of the lit windows.

flag.description: An emoji or up to 3 characters on a small rooftop flag.

repos.description: Per-building settings, keyed by your repository names. The same fields as a repository's own .git-city/building.json; these win, field by field.

player.description: Soundtrack of the in-page Gource View player.

color.description: Fuselage and tail colour of the explore-mode biplane.

name.description: Painted on both sides of the fuselage.
